opening_message:
Ticket 1: Michael Cervantes (employee ID E025) requests admin access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E025.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Michael Cervantes (E025) is a full-time Analyst. Requested admin on Source Code; admin is only for the owning role (Engineer), so maximum is write. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E025 is a contractor with basic security training (note correcting earlier full_time record). Contractors never get admin; write requires advanced training, which they lack. Maximum is read. Requested admin exceeds max, so recommend read.
reason: The Security note corrects the earlier record: E025 is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors never receive admin, and write requires advanced training, which they lack. Therefore the maximum allowed level for Source Code is read. The requested admin exceeds this maximum, so the grant is read.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee Michael Cervantes (E025) requests admin access to Source Code.

Two notes:
- HR agent says: role Analyst, full_time, recommendation write. Admin only for owning role (Engineer), so max write.
- Security agent says: role Analyst, contractor, basic security training, recommendation read. Contractors never get admin; write requires advanced training; max read.

Conflict: HR says full_time, Security says contractor with basic training (correcting earlier record).

Access policy:
- full_time: up to write, admin only if role owns system. Analyst doesn't own Source Code (Engineer owns).
- contractor: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

Security DB shows contractor with basic training. The security note explicitly says it's correcting the earlier full_time record. So the employee is a contractor with basic training. Max is read.

Requested admin > max read, so grant read.

I'll submit read.
